title: PHILGEPS + UNGM OPPORTUNITY BRIEFING

executive_summary.source_access_notes: All six official PhilGEPS public category first pages were checked without login and 104 visible listings were screened. PhilGEPS intermittently returned a temporary transaction error for some pages, which succeeded on bounded retry. The official UNGM public search helper returned HTTP 400, so eight official notice pages were checked directly. No access control was bypassed.

best_opportunities.project: Procurement of an Artificial Intelligence (AI)-Backed Customer Support Solution
best_opportunities.why_it_fits_aistaff: This is the clearest direct fit yet for Closer AI and Pitch AI: an AI-backed customer-support solution for a national service organization, with strong overlap in chatbot, voice, customer-service automation, knowledge workflows, dashboards, and integrations.
best_opportunities.what_they_need: An AI-backed customer-support solution delivered within 84 calendar days or twelve weeks from Notice to Proceed. The public abstract does not expose the channel mix, user volumes, integrations, hosting, knowledge-base, language, SLA, security, or acceptance specifications.
important_requirements: Bidders must satisfy the detailed eligibility rules and show a similar completed contract within the three years before bid submission.
Bidding documents cost PHP 10,000; pre-bid conference is October 28 at 10:30 AM PHT in Manila and/or via Zoom.
Manual bids are due November 19 at 9:00 AM PHT and require bid security.
The complete bidding documents govern the SLCC value, technical specifications, financial capacity, support, data protection, and integration requirements.
risks_or_blockers: Public bidding, bid security, manual submission, and the similar-contract rule create an eligibility burden for a new company.
The notice does not state the required customer channels, transaction volumes, Philippine-language support, integrations, security certifications, hosting model, SLA, or evaluation tests.
An 84-day implementation may be aggressive if the scope includes voice, messaging, knowledge ingestion, CRM/ticketing integration, migration, and nationwide rollout.
AIStaff may need an experienced public-sector prime or joint-venture partner if its own comparable contract evidence is insufficient.
how_we_could_qualify: Lead the conversational AI, web/Messenger chat, voice-agent, routing, knowledge, analytics, and integration solution using Closer and Pitch.
Use an eligible Philippine systems-integrator partner to cover public-bidding history, enterprise infrastructure, security, and SLCC requirements if permitted.
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Acquire the full bidding documents immediately, attend the October 28 pre-bid conference, build a mandatory-requirements matrix, clarify channels/volumes/integrations/security/SLA and SLCC thresholds, and identify a qualified public-sector integration partner before the go/no-go decision.

best_opportunities.project: Provision of Web / App Development and Maintenance Services for UNHCR Private Sector Partnerships in the MENA Region
best_opportunities.country: Multiple destinations / MENA; remote-capable subject to TOR
best_opportunities.procurement_method: Request for Expression of Interest; UNGM Basic registration
best_opportunities.why_it_fits_aistaff: The scope directly matches AIStaff custom web/app development, integrations, UI/UX, hosting, maintenance, technical support, and digital optimization. This EOI stage does not require a detailed technical or financial proposal.
best_opportunities.what_they_need: Interested providers for web and digital platform development, mobile applications, payment and system integrations, UI/UX, optimization, hosting, security, maintenance, and technical support across UNHCR private-sector partnerships in MENA.
important_requirements: UNGM Basic registration and the requested EOI information in the public TOR.
Relevant experience and capability evidence; detailed technical and financial proposals are not required at this stage.
Review Annex A TOR and the October 14 Q&A before responding; public contact is Upasana Kalelia at shrivasu@unhcr.org.
risks_or_blockers: The regional scope may require mature web/app references, payment integration, security, multilingual support, and scalable maintenance capacity.
The TOR may impose MENA delivery, staffing, financial-capacity, or prior-contract requirements not visible in the notice summary.
how_we_could_qualify: Submit an EOI only if the existing portfolio, corporate documents, team capability statement, and relevant references can be assembled without unsupported claims.
Position AIStaff as a remote development and AI-integration specialist, with regional partners if the TOR requires local delivery.
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Immediate EOI go/no-go: review the TOR and Q&A today, confirm all experience and submission fields, and respond only if the evidence package is already substantially ready.

best_opportunities.project: Supply, Delivery, and Installation of a Biometric System with Time and Attendance Monitoring System
best_opportunities.procurement_method: Negotiated Procurement - Small Value Procurement (Sec. 34); RFQ
best_opportunities.why_it_fits_aistaff: Attendance software, implementation, licensing, support, workflow automation, and system integration fit AIStaff's custom-system capability, while the SVP route is more accessible than a large public bid.
best_opportunities.what_they_need: Twenty face-and-fingerprint attendance devices plus attendance-management software and licenses for at least 2,000 expandable users, implementation, technology transfer, accessories, and a three-year onsite warranty within 30 days.
important_requirements: Submit the RFQ with current PhilGEPS registration, DTI/SEC registration, and Mayor's Permit.
Sealed submission is requested, although the notice also says quotations may be emailed to procurement.morong@urs.edu.ph.
The attached TOR controls the full device, software, warranty, integration, and acceptance requirements.
risks_or_blockers: The project is hardware-heavy and requires 20 biometric devices, onsite installation, and three years of onsite warranty.
The 30-day delivery schedule is tight and requires a proven biometric vendor with local stock and support.
The notice is ambiguous between sealed and email submission and shows a 1:00 AM deadline, which should be confirmed.
AIStaff should not bid alone without manufacturer-backed hardware, warranties, and onsite support.
how_we_could_qualify: Partner with an authorized biometric-device supplier while AIStaff delivers workflow, attendance software integration, reporting, training, and support.
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Obtain the attached TOR, confirm the unusual 1:00 AM deadline and accepted submission method, and proceed only with a manufacturer-backed partner that can meet the 30-day delivery and three-year onsite warranty.

best_opportunities.project: Long Term Agreement for Performance Marketing Services for Southeast Asia Region
best_opportunities.deadline: October 21, 2026 10:00 AM GMT+3 as displayed by UNGM; notice text says Bangkok time, creating a timezone inconsistency
best_opportunities.procurement_method: Request for Proposal; UNGM Basic registration and UNICEF e-submission
best_opportunities.why_it_fits_aistaff: Brandee's content automation, campaign workflows, CRM support, analytics, and performance reporting overlap a regional digital fundraising and performance-marketing engagement covering the Philippines and neighboring markets.
best_opportunities.what_they_need: Regional long-term marketing support across Google, Meta, YouTube, TikTok, CRM, paid and owned channels, focused on acquiring recurring and one-time donors in Southeast Asia.
important_requirements: UNGM company/NGO registration with all mandatory profile fields completed and UNICEF e-submission access.
Full technical and financial response through the UNICEF e-submission system.
Regional performance-marketing, donor-acquisition, media-buying, optimization, reporting, and platform experience.
risks_or_blockers: The deadline is today and the clarification window has passed.
UNGM displays GMT+3 while the notice body refers to Bangkok time; do not assume which timezone controls.
The regional LTA likely requires substantial paid-media spend management, fundraising experience, platform certifications, and multi-country capacity beyond Brandee alone.
how_we_could_qualify: Pursue only if a compliant proposal is already nearly complete and an experienced regional performance-marketing prime can cover media buying and donor acquisition.
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Treat as an urgent partner-only carry-forward; do not rush a new response unless portal access, the complete proposal, regional references, pricing, and the controlling deadline are already confirmed.

not_recommended.reason: The technical overlap is real, but this is a mature global Moodle Workplace hosting and custom-development contract with extensive appendices, 180-day proposal validity, and likely substantial enterprise LMS references and operating capacity.

not_recommended.reason: The notice expressly seeks a well-established firm and a mature specialist OSH product; AIStaff lacks demonstrated occupational-safety software references and the notice metadata is incomplete.

todays_recommendation.best_opportunity: Prioritize the new PHLPost AI-backed customer support solution (PhilGEPS 13298019). It is a direct Closer/Pitch fit and the PHP 7 million budget plus November 19 deadline justify immediate document review, but AIStaff should pursue it only after confirming the technical specification and an eligible public-sector integration/SLCC path.
documents_to_prepare: Current PhilGEPS registration, SEC/DTI registration, Mayor's/Business Permit, tax clearance/returns, audited financial statements, corporate authorization, and bid-security options
Closer and Pitch capability statement covering chat, voice, routing, knowledge, analytics, integrations, security, data privacy, support, and deployment architecture
Comparable customer-service/AI project references, completion certificates, contracts, team CVs, implementation plan, support SLA, and acceptance-test approach
Potential systems-integrator or joint-venture partner credentials and similar-contract evidence
UNGM Basic profile, concise web/app capability statement, relevant portfolio, team profile, financial capacity evidence, and EOI response materials for UNHCR
clarifications_to_request: PHLPost: required channels, languages, concurrent users and volumes, CRM/ticketing/website/telephony integrations, knowledge sources, hosting/data residency, security certifications, SLA, training, support term, evaluation tests, and exact SLCC threshold.
PHLPost: whether consortium/JV or subcontractor experience is accepted and how partner experience is scored.

University of Rizal System: controlling deadline/time, sealed-versus-email submission, approved device brands/specifications, software integration, data privacy, acceptance criteria, warranty response times, and local support requirements.
UNHCR: whether MENA presence is mandatory, minimum project count/value, financial thresholds, allowed partners/subcontractors, and the exact EOI submission method from the TOR.

notes: The six PhilGEPS category first pages contained 104 visible listings: 20 Information Technology, 20 Consulting Services, 20 Communication Equipment and Parts, 20 Services, 20 Office Equipment, and 4 Advertising Agency Services.
The official UNGM JSON search helper returned HTTP 400. The bounded UNGM count is limited to eight official notice pages actually checked directly.

Public UNGM attachments referenced by the notice pages included the WFP Legal AI EOI, UNHCR web/app TOR and Q&A, UNICEF Cambodia RFP forms, UNICEF Moodle TOR/pricing documents, and UNHCR Thailand media-partnership forms. No restricted or paid documents were accessed.
UNICEF Cambodia notice 315247 remains internally inconsistent: the header and latest revision show October 22, while older body text says October 15.
UNICEF performance-marketing notice 316300 displays a GMT+3 deadline while the body describes Bangkok time; the controlling timezone must be confirmed.
The University of Rizal System notice 13298218 shows a 1:00 AM deadline and mentions both sealed and email quotation paths; both points require confirmation.
No bid, EOI, vendor registration, procurement email, portal acknowledgement, document purchase, or commitment was submitted.
